navbar.notes: navy-900 top bar, fixed 64px height, 2px brand-red bottom border; app icon + 'StockFlow' title on the left, nav links on the right; navbar shadow; active link uses brand-red

page.notes: warm-oat (#F9F7F4) background; centered content column max-width 960px; page__header contains app icon + page title; page__title for the H1

card.notes: white surface (#FFFFFF) on warm-oat background; --radius-md (8px); --shadow-sm navy-tinted shadow; --space-5 (20px) padding; used for stock table and detail panels

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red #FF3621, sharp 0px corners, hover #EB1600); btn--secondary (outlined, --radius-md); btn--ghost (text-only, no border)

form_input.notes: persistent visible label above input (never placeholder-only); --radius-sm (4px) border; focus ring using --color-info (#0176D3); inline validation error shown next to the field naming the field; min tap target 44x44px

stock_table.notes: cool uppercase header row; quantity cells right-aligned using --font-mono with tabular-nums font-variant; scannable layout with generous whitespace; lives inside a card

status_badge.notes: pill shape (--radius-pill); --text-xs uppercase; meaning carried by BOTH text label AND color, never color alone; variants: badge--in-stock (success green + 'In Stock'), badge--low (warning amber + 'Low'), badge--out (error red + 'Out'), badge--on-order (info blue + 'On Order'), badge--quarantined (navy-500 + 'Quarantined')

empty_state.notes: icon (line-style warehouse/stock icon) + teaching heading + explanatory copy + a CTA button; e.g. 'No stock at this location, receive an inbound shipment'; never a blank region or silent null

toast.notes: fixed top-right positioning; success toast auto-dismisses; error toast persists until dismissed; never shifts page layout; role=alert for screen readers

scan_zone.notes: barcode scan input area; success state flashes green and updates the stock row in place; failure state (unknown barcode, locked SKU) flashes red and triggers a persistent error toast; data-testid=scan-zone
